title: Code for: Trisomy 21 Perturbs Oligodendrocyte Developmental States and Oligo–Neuron Communication in Human Forebrain Assembloids
description: Analysis code for single-cell and single-nucleus RNA-seq of euploid and trisomy 21 iPSC-derived forebrain assembloids at 150 days in vitro: quality control, integration, OLLC subclustering, Celda modules, Slingshot pseudotime, scMetaIntegrator differential expression, CellChat and comparison with human fetal and early postnatal reference data.
